spiritgiven.comments: Retracted calls when appropriate and their spirit captain really went out of their way to be a symbol and example of what spirit should look like.

Many calls were contested very quickly and the discussions were not fruitful. Several calls were maintained even when our players tried to explain a different perspective. Sideline became involved in the calls on a few occasions without being asked to. These points were brought up with the spirit captain at halftime however the adjustment was not made. We recognize the language barrier and the long discussions were not a factor in this score.
Though there were many instances of fouls after catches, they were open to communicating with our players and coming to an agreement quickly and with respect.
Actively tried to avoid contact and all comments on the sideline/field were positive. Really great game!
Very spirited game, they kept giving 100% all throughout the game. All calls were resolved quickly and with respect.
Positive attitude all throughout the game, gave 100% effort and made adjustments until the end. Really fun team to play against!
Great spirited game, all calls were resolved quickly and communication was clear. Fun game overall!

spiritreceived.comments: Body contact was improved in the latter half. Communicated well. Thank you for a spirited game!

We really appreciate your receptiveness and responsiveness to feedback.
Body contact - there was an attempt to improve body contact after discussion between spirit captains during the first half. It did improve across some of your team but there were still individual players who maintained the same level of physicality, particularly on the catch.
It was an enjoyable and competitive game!

We felt that the WFDF rules weren't always applied throughout the game (a few confusions with usau). When it came to calls we felt that a fair resolution wasn't always found and that there was a strong sense of purposefully not backing down for initial opinion despite decent conversations.

TC! What a great game, eh? We had so much fun beavering away against you, and really appreciated all the positivity on and off the field. Calls were fairly and clearly communicated down to every last timbit. We asked for a low contact game and you delivered, even despite the high level of intensity - it really toque our breath away. We’ll be cheering you on in the rest of the tournament, envoie la!
Well done on adjusting your body contact compared to our pool game. Communication was also clear and calm. An enjoyable game, good luck for the final!
